label: Playwright Chromium

identityCopy.notes: Identity tier for the stock Playwright Chromium profile: Local State (it holds the key that decrypts every cookie and password below, so it is copied first), Preferences, saved logins, cookies, autofill, history, localStorage and session-storage tokens, extension state and the installed extensions themselves. No fingerprint seed exists in this engine. Left out: IndexedDB, the OPFS file system, caches and metrics dumps, which is why sites whose login lives in IndexedDB may ask you to sign in again. A copy on a busy base can be seconds stale.

notes: Stock Playwright Chromium through cloakbrowser-mcp. Same 74 backend tools as cloak (72 browser plus 2 local diagnostics), but the stealth patches are absent because PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_BROWSER_ENGINE selects the stock browser.
